## ⚠️ Breaking changes (v0.6.1 -> v0.7.0)

v0.7.0 rebuilds installation, training, inference and the hardware layer. A few changes need your attention when upgrading:

**Installation**
- On Linux, `torch` and `torchvision` now come from PyPI as CUDA 13 builds (NVIDIA driver 580.65 or newer); the `cu128` index is gone. For older drivers, install torch from a CUDA 12 index first (see the installation guide). macOS needs 14+ (15+ for MPS).
- Pins moved: `transformers` 5.22, `huggingface-hub>=1.31,<3`, `motorbridge` 0.5, `datasets<6`, `Pillow<14`, `torchcodec<0.18`.

**Training**
- Weights & Biases is replaced by Trackio (the `training` extra installs `trackio`): `--wandb.*` is now `--trackio.*`, `entity`/`mode` have no equivalent, remote jobs with tracking need `--trackio.space_id`, and checkpoints are no longer uploaded as artifacts by default.
- FSDP1 is replaced by FSDP2/HSDP (`--parallelism.dp_shard`, `--parallelism.dp_replicate`, `--accelerator.*`); mixed precision is set with `--accelerator.mixed_precision`. FSDP checkpoints saved with lerobot ≤ 0.6.x cannot be resumed (their `model.safetensors` still loads), and Accelerate YAML/env configuration is rejected unless `LEROBOT_ALLOW_ACCELERATE_ENV=1`.
- `--policy.use_peft=true` alone now trains LoRA instead of silently fully fine-tuning.
- Image transforms

watchlist_releases.body:
# Newton v1.8.0rc1

Newton v1.8.0rc1 is the first release candidate for Newton 1.8, following v1.7.0. It introduces the experimental Steel articulated rigid-body solver and adds routed tendons, richer deformable workflows, core passive joint springs, and a new Kamino dynamics backend, along with broad collision and model-building performance work. Please validate existing scenes against the migration notes below, especially XPBD stiffness tuning, Rod joints, imported joint springs, MuJoCo kinematic roots, and console output that now goes through the `newton` logger.

This release candidate's changes are still recorded as pending changelog fragments; see the [complete list of changes](https://github.com/newton-physics/newton/tree/v1.8.0rc1/changelog). A consolidated changelog will follow in a later release candidate.

## Highlights

- **Experimental: Steel articulated rigid-body solver.** `SolverSteel` combines Featherstone articulated-body dynamics with a projected Gauss-Seidel contact solve that has coupled Coulomb friction. It supports friction patches, loop-closing and mimic joints, joint friction, opt-in run-to-run determinism, passive-island sleeping, CUDA graph capture, and use inside the coupled solvers.
